reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay path in shared/schedules.ts with one exported isHoliday and reuses it in the server's daily range code; that site still composes weekend-or-holiday itself rather than sharing isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The holiday match rule exists once; the only repeat is the pre-existing weekend||holiday composition in getDatesInRange, which the diff keeps rather than adds.

placement.why: The date-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend-skipping logic that consumes it.

scope.why: Only the holiday matcher, its two call sites and tests change.

maintainability.why: A small, well-named predicate every holiday check goes through; minor nits are the long unformatted line and unsorted import.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both holiday checks (isNonWorkingDay and the daily branch of getDatesInRange) call the new isHoliday.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the MM-DD rule is defined once in isHoliday.
